PAGE TITLE: APÉNDICE 15 DE NOVIEMBRE DE 2024
Mensaje del Administrador (CONTINUACIÓN)

PHOTOS: Headshot of Bill Nelson with his handwritten signature and printed name "Bill Nelson" below, captioned "Atentamente,".

KEY FACTS:
- In Fiscal Year 2024, NASA marked the Crew-8 and Crew-9 crewed launches to the ISS aboard SpaceX rockets under the Commercial Crew Program.
- NASA's fleet includes over two dozen satellites and instruments, providing over 60 years of climate observation data.
- The NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) mission is the first radar of its kind in space to systematically map Earth using two radar frequencies.
- In January 2024, NASA publicly unveiled the X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft designed to reduce sonic booms.
- The Sustainable Flight Demonstrator X-66 is an experimental aircraft focused on helping achieve net-zero aviation emissions by 2050.
- The 2024-2026 STEM Engagement Strategic Implementation Plan supports NASA's strategy in STEM.
